calls.title: May 29, 05:58 PM
calls.summary: The meeting outlined plans for launching a proof of concept (POC) targeted for mid-June, with a budget of $50,000 for an enterprise license that includes 10 users at $40,000 plus $1,000 per user. User access will be limited to key stakeholders, primarily product managers, to enhance focused testing and feedback. A Slack Connect channel will be established for real-time communication during POC execution. Technical requirements were discussed, emphasizing the need to verify data sufficiency with Redshift, and an AA test is scheduled to validate the statistical accuracy of the findings. Legal and InfoSec reviews will take place two weeks before the POC begins, facilitating thorough contract examination. The evaluation will prioritize fit and functionality, with a production decision expected by late June or early July.
calls.keywords: Proof of Concept, Enterprise License, Redshift Integration, Data Warehouse, Technical Due Diligence, Slack Connect
calls.action_items:
**Scott Keller**
Send instructions for refreshing the enterprise license and setting up user access to the client team (05:00)
Create and manage a Slack Connect channel to facilitate direct communication for the POC before its official start (08:00)
Provide Master Service Agreement (MSA) and order form documentation to the client for legal, InfoSec, and compliance review (08:20)
Coordinate parallel handling of contracts and initiate technical due diligence starting mid-June (09:00)

**Jeff**
Invite relevant product management and technical team members to the Slack channel after the company off-site to enable collaboration (11:40)
Lead internal legal, security, and compliance reviews of the provided documentation to ensure GDPR and third-party vendor alignment (08:30)
Confirm resourcing and availability for POC tasks, coordinating involvement from data science and site platform teams (10:30)

**Logan**
Support integration efforts and clarify schema details related to Redshift and Kafka data pipelines during the POC (06:50)

**Unassigned**
Clarify whether the data volume and event coverage in Redshift are sufficient for accurate experimentation analysis during the POC (11:00)
